title: AI Assistant for Real Estate Agents
description:
In this #TheAgentGoldmine clip, we explore how using an AI assistant, even one you can wear, can simplify room-to-room walkthroughs by handling note-taking and recalling important client details, so nothing gets missed.

Watch the full episode!

Love,
Ali & Shelby
